name: Margaret
note: co-ruler with her husbands John III of Armagnac, John of Armagnac and Mathieu of Foix; at Mathieu's death in 1453 Comminges was reunited to the French crown

name: Jean de Lescun
note: in 1462 Louis XI detached the county from the royal domain and gave it to him

name: Odet d'Aydie
note: in 1498 at his death Louis XII definitively reunited the county to the French crown; later counts titular only; born c. 1425
